comment: Two populated boards summed: the 18x17 main board and a 15x5 clipping-diode board for the 6-position rotary; each has a bare cuts view beside or below it. On the diode board D12-D13 are jumpers and are not listed; the main board has its own D13-D14 (1N914), so the designator D13 is used twice.
